items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Both Jackie Cain and Junior Mance have told me about him

ctx.x: Both Jackie Cain and Junior Mance have told me about him, because they’re both a year younger than you are but basically came up at around the same time, so they both worked with that band, I guess, at some point or other.
Well, not when I was on it, I think Lou was the pianist, but I’m not sure of that now. I actually sang the blues [in] that band.
